jokes.setup: Why did the higher-or-lower player bring a ladder?
jokes.punchline: They had a feeling the answer was higher.

jokes.setup: Why does the Eiffel Tower grow in summer?
jokes.punchline: Too many croissants on holiday.

jokes.setup: Why did the polar bear fail the penguin-spotting test?
jokes.punchline: Wrong pole.

jokes.setup: Why do octopuses make great quiz partners?
jokes.punchline: They put three hearts into every answer.

jokes.setup: Why is a snail's dentist always busy?
jokes.punchline: Every snail has thousands of teeth to check.

jokes.setup: What does a goldfish say about its three-second memory?
jokes.punchline: It's a myth. And it'll remember you said that for months.

jokes.setup: Why did the detectives question the koala?
jokes.punchline: Its fingerprints were all over the case.

jokes.setup: Why do giraffes make terrible secret agents?
jokes.punchline: They can't stop sticking their necks out.

jokes.setup: What's a crab's favourite subject?
jokes.punchline: Maths. It's got ten legs to count on.

jokes.setup: Why did the bat get top marks in biology?
jokes.punchline: It was the only mammal that could fly through the test.

jokes.setup: Why was the strawberry crying?
jokes.punchline: It found out it isn't a berry. The banana is.

jokes.setup: Why does Jupiter always rush its homework?
jokes.punchline: Its days are only ten hours long.

jokes.setup: Why did Pluto stop going to planet parties after 2006?
jokes.punchline: It wasn't on the list any more.

jokes.setup: Why is Saturn so popular?
jokes.punchline: It has over 200 moons following it around.

jokes.setup: Why won't zero let anyone call it odd?
jokes.punchline: It's even, and it's got the maths to prove it.

jokes.setup: Why is a leap year always so cheerful?
jokes.punchline: It gets an extra day off.

jokes.setup: Why did the Romans find algebra so easy?
jokes.punchline: X was always 10.

jokes.setup: Why didn't the Vikings really wear horned helmets?
jokes.punchline: They kept getting stuck in the longhouse door.

jokes.setup: What did Napoleon say when someone called him short?
jokes.punchline: I'm average for my time. Check the sources.

jokes.setup: What's the Leaning Tower of Pisa's favourite exercise?
jokes.punchline: Side bends.

jokes.setup: Why is Big Ben always a bit confused?
jokes.punchline: Everyone calls the whole tower by his name, and he's only the bell.

jokes.setup: Why did the Matterhorn feel left out?
jokes.punchline: Everyone kept mistaking it for a chocolate bar.

jokes.setup: Why are Dead Sea swimming lessons so short?
jokes.punchline: Everyone passes the floating test straight away.

jokes.setup: Why does the Danube get so many postcards?
jokes.punchline: It has friends in ten countries.

jokes.setup: Why does Canberra feel so left out?
jokes.punchline: Everyone keeps guessing Sydney.

jokes.setup: Why did the geyser get a job at the café?
jokes.punchline: It's brilliant at letting off steam.

jokes.setup: Why do fjords make tricky friends?
jokes.punchline: They're very deep, but a bit narrow-minded.

jokes.setup: Why did the footballer bring string to the match?
jokes.punchline: To tie the game.

jokes.setup: Why did the sprinter get disqualified from quiz night?
jokes.punchline: She kept answering before the gun.

jokes.setup: Why are Le Mans drivers so tired?
jokes.punchline: Twenty-four hours is a long time to go round in circles.

jokes.setup: Why did the Lamborghini stop at the farm?
jokes.punchline: It wanted to visit the tractors and the bulls. Old friends.

jokes.setup: What do Mary Quant's miniskirt and the Mini car have in common?
jokes.punchline: Not much leg room.

jokes.setup: Why did the jeans go on holiday to Nîmes?
jokes.punchline: To get back to their roots.

jokes.setup: What did the wellington boot say to the puddle?
jokes.punchline: You're no Waterloo.

jokes.setup: Why did the Jaffa Cake go to court?
jokes.punchline: To prove it wasn't a biscuit. It won.

jokes.setup: Why is Marmite so good at arguments?
jokes.punchline: Half the room is always on its side.

jokes.setup: Why won't tea boil properly on Everest?
jokes.punchline: It only gets to 70 degrees and comes out feeling weak.

jokes.setup: Why was Mickey Mouse upset in 2006?
jokes.punchline: Someone said Pluto wasn't a planet any more.

jokes.setup: Why is Pluto jealous of Goofy?
jokes.punchline: They're both dogs, but only one of them got trousers.

jokes.setup: Why is Disney's Robin Hood so good at quizzes?
jokes.punchline: He's a sly fox who never misses.

jokes.setup: What's Olaf's favourite thing about a warm hug?
jokes.punchline: Everything. Which is exactly the problem.

jokes.setup: Why did Pinocchio lose the quiz?
jokes.punchline: Every time he bluffed, his nose gave it away.

jokes.setup: Why does Gromit never say the answer out loud?
jokes.punchline: He just raises an eyebrow and waits for you to catch up.

jokes.setup: Why did King Harald have a blue tooth?
jokes.punchline: Nobody knows, but his phone pairs beautifully.

jokes.setup: Why did the higher-or-lower question go to therapy?
jokes.punchline: Too many ups and downs.

jokes.setup: What did the yes-or-no question say on its first date?
jokes.punchline: Let's keep this simple.

jokes.setup: What did the drone bee put on its CV?
jokes.punchline: Doesn't sting, doesn't work, great company.

jokes.setup: Why does a parliament of owls never get anything done?
jokes.punchline: Every time someone speaks, the rest just say 'Who?'

jokes.setup: What do you call a group of crows planning a quiz night?
jokes.punchline: A murder mystery.

jokes.setup: Why does the Sphinx always win at riddles?
jokes.punchline: It wrote half of them.

jokes.setup: Why did the pyramid builders never get lost?
jokes.punchline: They always followed the point.

jokes.setup: Why did Stonehenge go to the doctor?
jokes.punchline: Its back had been stiff for 5,000 years.

jokes.setup: Why did Everest and K2 stop talking?
jokes.punchline: K2 got tired of being looked down on.

jokes.setup: Why hasn't Mount Fuji erupted since 1707?
jokes.punchline: It decided to be the calm one in all the photos.

jokes.setup: What did the Colorado River say to the Grand Canyon?
jokes.punchline: Sorry, I know I've been going on about this for millions of years.

jokes.setup: Why has nobody ever found the Loch Ness Monster?
jokes.punchline: It's hiding in more water than all of England and Wales put together.

jokes.setup: Why does the Spirit of Ecstasy never get carsick?
jokes.punchline: She always sits at the very front.

jokes.setup: Why don't Formula One cars stop to refuel any more?
jokes.punchline: They start the race full of themselves.

jokes.setup: Why was every Model T painted black?
jokes.punchline: Every other colour was still drying.

jokes.setup: Why does a Vespa always buzz off so quickly?
jokes.punchline: It's Italian for wasp.

jokes.setup: Why does Tom never catch Jerry?
jokes.punchline: Seven Oscars say he shouldn't.

jokes.setup: How does Scooby-Doo solve every mystery?
jokes.punchline: He follows the snacks, and the snacks always lead to the culprit.

jokes.setup: Why did the Minion fail its French test?
jokes.punchline: It answered every question in six languages at once.

jokes.setup: Why doesn't the Gruffalo ever enter quizzes?
jokes.punchline: Everyone knows there's no such thing.

jokes.setup: Why was the penguin wandering around the Sahara?
jokes.punchline: It took a wrong turn at the equator.

jokes.setup: Why did the cheetah challenge the greyhound to a race?
jokes.punchline: It fancied a guaranteed win.

jokes.setup: Why don't flamingos play football?
jokes.punchline: They'd only ever use one leg.

jokes.setup: Why do pandas do so well in quizzes about bamboo?
jokes.punchline: They've never studied anything else.

jokes.setup: Why did the blue whale join the quiz team?
jokes.punchline: It wanted to be part of something big.

jokes.setup: What did the light year say when someone called it a unit of time?
jokes.punchline: Distance yourself from that answer.

jokes.setup: Why was the barometer so moody?
jokes.punchline: It was under a lot of pressure.

jokes.setup: Why did the periodic table get a gold star?
jokes.punchline: It had Au the right elements.

jokes.setup: What do you get if you cross a snowman with a quiz?
jokes.punchline: Brain freeze.

jokes.setup: Why is the Christmas tree so good at quizzes?
jokes.punchline: It knows all the branches of knowledge.

jokes.setup: Why did the magnet's friends worry about it?
jokes.punchline: It kept pulling in the wrong ones and pushing the right ones away.

jokes.setup: What was Henry VIII's best dating advice?
jokes.punchline: Keep your head. Not everyone did.

jokes.setup: My doctor told me to do more cardio.
jokes.punchline: So I've started arguing at quiz night.

jokes.setup: I told my partner they're the answer to all my questions.
jokes.punchline: They said, 'Then why do you keep getting them wrong?'

jokes.setup: Are you a higher-or-lower question?
jokes.punchline: Because my heart rate's definitely going higher.

jokes.setup: Are you today's ten?
jokes.punchline: Because I'd come back every single day just to keep the streak going.

jokes.setup: People say I've got the memory of a goldfish.
jokes.punchline: Joke's on them. Goldfish remember things for months. I can't find my keys.

jokes.setup: Why did the snowman's wife leave him?
jokes.punchline: He was a total flake.

jokes.setup: Why does Dracula always win the pub quiz?
jokes.punchline: He was there for most of the answers.

jokes.setup: I'd tell you a joke about the Mariana Trench.
jokes.punchline: But it's far too deep for this time of night.

jokes.setup: Why is a Hunch-off like Christmas dinner?
jokes.punchline: Somebody always storms off before the scores are in.

jokes.setup: I tried speed dating at the Tour de France.
jokes.punchline: Everyone just rode straight past.

jokes.setup: Are you The Kiss by Klimt?
jokes.punchline: Because I could stare at you for hours and still not understand what's going on.

jokes.setup: Are you Mount Damavand?
jokes.punchline: Because you're hot, and I'm not convinced you're as dormant as you look.

jokes.setup: My love life is a lot like Pluto.
jokes.punchline: Officially downgraded, and still going round in circles.

jokes.setup: Why did the Viking's wife take him to couples therapy?
jokes.punchline: She said he was far too horny. Historians say that's a myth.

jokes.setup: My other half asked if I'm a good loser.
jokes.punchline: I said, 'Have you seen my Hunchy scores? I'm a professional.'

jokes.setup: Why did the Grim Reaper win the pub quiz?
jokes.punchline: He already knew everyone's final answer.

jokes.setup: Why did the bottle of wine join the quiz team?
jokes.punchline: It said it gets better with age. Three glasses in, nobody was getting better.

jokes.setup: Why is marriage like a yes-or-no question?
jokes.punchline: There's always a right answer. You just find out later which one it was.

jokes.setup: Are you a yes-or-no question?
jokes.punchline: Because I already know my answer.

jokes.setup: Are you the speed of light?
jokes.punchline: Because you've just gone round my head seven times in one second.

jokes.setup: My diet's going really well.
jokes.punchline: I only eat things that are scientifically fruit. Tomatoes, cucumbers, and the peppers on my pizza.

jokes.setup: My bank balance is like the Dead Sea.
jokes.punchline: Well below sea level, and somehow it keeps getting lower.

jokes.setup: My partner and I settle our arguments with a Hunch-off.
jokes.punchline: It's like a divorce, but with sources.

jokes.setup: Why are cats like bad losers at Hunchy?
jokes.punchline: They never admit a wrong answer. They just knock the phone off the table.

jokes.setup: Are you a question I got wrong?
jokes.punchline: Because I can't stop thinking about you.

jokes.setup: Are you a multiple-choice question?
jokes.punchline: Because you're the only option I'd ever pick.

jokes.setup: Are you the Great Wall of China?
jokes.punchline: Because I've been trying to get over you for years.

jokes.setup: Are you the Grand Canyon?
jokes.punchline: Because I've fallen for you, and it's a very long way down.

jokes.setup: Are you the Equator?
jokes.punchline: Because it gets noticeably hotter wherever you go.

jokes.setup: Are you Antarctica?
jokes.punchline: Because you're cool, nobody owns you, and I'd still cross an ocean to see you.

jokes.setup: Are you an F1 pit stop?
jokes.punchline: Because I've known you for two seconds and you've already changed everything.

jokes.setup: Are you the Summer Olympics?
jokes.punchline: Because I'd wait four years for you, and I'd still turn up early.

jokes.setup: Are you the North Pole?
jokes.punchline: Because my compass keeps pointing straight at you.

jokes.setup: Are you a rainbow?
jokes.punchline: Because I'd chase you all day and never quite catch up.

jokes.setup: Are you dry ice?
jokes.punchline: Because you're cool, and you make everything around you look dramatic.

jokes.setup: Are you mercury?
jokes.punchline: Because you're impossible to hold on to, and everyone says to be careful around you.

jokes.setup: Are you the Moon?
jokes.punchline: Because even my tides change when you walk past.

jokes.setup: Are you a chemistry question?
jokes.punchline: Because there's definitely a reaction going on here.

jokes.setup: Are you Venus?
jokes.punchline: Because one day with you feels longer than a year, in the best possible way.

jokes.setup: Are you the Golden Gate Bridge?
jokes.punchline: Because you're gorgeous, a bit foggy in the mornings, and worth every penny of the toll.

jokes.setup: Are you the Rosetta Stone?
jokes.punchline: Because since I met you, everything finally makes sense.

jokes.setup: Are you a penalty shootout?
jokes.punchline: Because my heart can't take much more of this.

jokes.setup: Are you Wimbledon?
jokes.punchline: Because I'd queue all night just for a glimpse of you.

jokes.setup: Are you a Grand Prix?
jokes.punchline: Because you've had me going round in circles all evening.

jokes.setup: Are you a googol?
jokes.punchline: Because that's how many times I've checked whether you've replied.

jokes.setup: Are you pi?
jokes.punchline: Because you're irrational, you go on and on, and I still can't get enough of you.

jokes.setup: Are you Niagara Falls?
jokes.punchline: Because people travel a very long way just to stand and stare at you.

jokes.setup: Are you a Masters green jacket?
jokes.punchline: Because I'd do anything to have you round my shoulders.

jokes.setup: Are you the Northern Lights?
jokes.punchline: Because I'd stand out in the freezing cold all night for one look at you.

jokes.setup: I met someone special at the pub quiz.
jokes.punchline: It was love at first wrong answer.

jokes.setup: Why did the Statue of Liberty never get asked out?
jokes.punchline: Everyone could see she was carrying a torch for someone.

jokes.setup: Why did the Leaning Tower of Pisa never get married?
jokes.punchline: Every time it fell for someone, it stopped halfway.

jokes.setup: Why did Big Ben's last relationship end?
jokes.punchline: It was all face, and it only ever wanted to talk about time.

jokes.setup: Why is the Eiffel Tower so good at flirting?
jokes.punchline: It knows exactly when to start sparkling.

jokes.setup: Why did the Amazon and the Nile break up?
jokes.punchline: They could never agree on which of them was longer.

jokes.setup: Why did the volcano's first date go so well?
jokes.punchline: It couldn't stop gushing.

jokes.setup: Why did the magnet keep getting dumped?
jokes.punchline: It was attractive, but only from one side.

jokes.setup: Why don't electrons settle down?
jokes.punchline: They're always negative, and they never stay in one place.

jokes.setup: Why do tennis players struggle with romance?
jokes.punchline: To them, love means nothing.

jokes.setup: Why did the cricketer's relationship fall apart?
jokes.punchline: Five whole days together, and it still ended in a draw.

jokes.setup: I've been on so many first dates this year.
jokes.punchline: My small talk now comes with sources and an 'as of' date.

jokes.setup: My date asked what I look for in a partner.
jokes.punchline: Someone who knows the capital of Australia and doesn't make a big deal of it.

jokes.setup: Speed dating didn't go well.
jokes.punchline: Apparently you can't ask people if you're higher or lower than their ex.

jokes.setup: My dating profile says I love long walks.
jokes.punchline: Mostly to the fridge, with the occasional detour to the pub.

jokes.setup: The secret to online dating is honesty.
jokes.punchline: And a very slightly blurry photo.

jokes.setup: I told my date I'm really into astronomy.
jokes.punchline: They said, 'Great. I'll give you some space.'

jokes.setup: On our first date I said I was a real catch.
jokes.punchline: By the third date they'd checked my sources.

jokes.setup: We met during the music round.
jokes.punchline: Neither of us knew the song, but we both swore it was ABBA.

jokes.setup: My partner says I'm like a fine cheese.
jokes.punchline: Strong, mature, and best kept in another room.

jokes.setup: My partner says I'm like a fine wine.
jokes.punchline: I get more expensive every year and I give them headaches.

jokes.setup: My partner calls me their Mona Lisa.
jokes.punchline: They say it's my mysterious smile. I think it's because I never leave the sofa.

jokes.setup: My partner asked if I'd still love them when they're old and wrinkly.
jokes.punchline: I said, 'I do already, don't I?'

jokes.setup: My partner asked what I'd grab first in a fire.
jokes.punchline: I said the Wi-Fi password. They're still not speaking to me.

jokes.setup: My partner says I'm as stubborn as a mule.
jokes.punchline: Mules are actually very sensible animals, and I'll be checking that.

jokes.setup: My partner threatened to leave if I said one more fun fact.
jokes.punchline: Fun fact: they're still here.

jokes.setup: What's the secret to a long and happy marriage?
jokes.punchline: Separate duvets and a shared enemy: the quiz team on table four.

jokes.setup: Our wedding vows said 'in sickness and in health'.
jokes.punchline: Nobody mentioned a cold that lasts two weeks and needs hourly updates.

jokes.setup: We've been together so long, we finish each other's sentences.
jokes.punchline: Then we argue about whose source was better.

jokes.setup: Why do couples love a Hunch-off?
jokes.punchline: It's the only argument where someone has to admit they were wrong.

jokes.setup: My other half bought me a fitness tracker.
jokes.punchline: It now knows more about my laziness than they do, and it's just as disappointed.

jokes.setup: Why was the wedding quiz such a hit?
jokes.punchline: Even the happy couple couldn't agree on how they met.

jokes.setup: Why do Formula One drivers make terrible partners?
jokes.punchline: They're always checking their mirrors and they'll never stop to ask for directions.

jokes.setup: Why do golfers make difficult partners?
jokes.punchline: They leave at dawn, come home at dusk, and still say they had a bad day.

jokes.setup: Why are darts players secretly romantic?
jokes.punchline: They always aim for the heart, even if they mostly hit the wall.

jokes.setup: My partner says I'm like the weather forecast.
jokes.punchline: Confident in the morning, and completely wrong by lunchtime.

jokes.setup: My partner says I only have two moods.
jokes.punchline: Quiz night, and waiting for quiz night.

jokes.setup: I asked my partner to sum me up in three words.
jokes.punchline: They said, 'Needs more sources.'

jokes.setup: My partner says I never remember anniversaries.
jokes.punchline: Which is odd, because I know the date of the Battle of Hastings.

jokes.setup: I'm not old.
jokes.punchline: I'm 'classic'. Hunchy says so, so it must be true.

jokes.setup: My body is a lot like the Great Wall of China.
jokes.punchline: Very old, a bit crumbly, and not nearly as visible from space as people think.

jokes.setup: My memory is like a museum.
jokes.punchline: Full of ancient things, and most of it is in storage I can't get to.

jokes.setup: My knees can now predict the weather.
jokes.punchline: They're more accurate than the forecast and twice as dramatic.

jokes.setup: I make a noise every time I sit down now.
jokes.punchline: My partner calls it my Formula One start.

jokes.setup: You know you're getting on a bit
jokes.punchline: when a big night out means staying up for the end of the news.

jokes.setup: I've started a new fitness plan, inspired by the Olympics.
jokes.punchline: I turn up every four years and expect a medal.

jokes.setup: I'm on the 5 A Day plan.
jokes.punchline: It's going really well. Mostly grapes, mostly fermented.

jokes.setup: My fitness tracker says I've climbed Everest this year.
jokes.punchline: Mostly the stairs, mostly at midnight, mostly for cheese.

jokes.setup: Why do marathon runners make tiring company?
jokes.punchline: They go the distance, then talk about it for the next six weeks.

jokes.setup: Wine is a lot like a quiz question.
jokes.punchline: The more you have, the more confident you get, and the less right you are.

jokes.setup: Why is a hangover like Antarctica?
jokes.punchline: It's freezing, it's silent, and you swear you'll never go back.

jokes.setup: Why did the quiz team bring a designated driver?
jokes.punchline: Somebody had to remember the answers.

jokes.setup: There are two kinds of people at a pub quiz.
jokes.punchline: Those who know the answers, and those who knew them all along, right after they were read out.

jokes.setup: I've been banned from my local pub quiz.
jokes.punchline: Apparently 'just checking the time' under the table for five minutes is cheating.

jokes.setup: My friend is so competitive,
jokes.punchline: they asked for a recount on a yes-or-no question.

jokes.setup: What's the most dangerous thing to say at a dinner party?
jokes.punchline: 'Who fancies a Hunch-off?' Friendships have ended before dessert.

jokes.setup: Every quiz team has one person who argues with the quizmaster.
jokes.punchline: I'd like to say it isn't me, but I'd need to check my sources.

jokes.setup: Why did the prosecco sit out the music round?
jokes.punchline: It was feeling a bit flat.

jokes.setup: I only drink on special occasions.
jokes.punchline: Quiz night, a penalty shootout, and any day the bin goes out.

jokes.setup: Meetings are a lot like the Bermuda Triangle.
jokes.punchline: You go in, and hours later nobody knows what happened.

jokes.setup: The office fridge is like a black hole.
jokes.punchline: Everything goes in, and nothing ever comes back out. Especially my lunch.

jokes.setup: Why did the office quiz end early?
jokes.punchline: Somebody asked who actually does any work round here, and nobody had an answer.

jokes.setup: My plants keep dying.
jokes.punchline: I'm starting to think I might be the common factor.

jokes.setup: My bank card is a lot like Concorde.
jokes.punchline: Fast, very expensive, and these days it mostly stays on the ground.

jokes.setup: My cooking is like a volcano.
jokes.punchline: Smoke everywhere, alarms going off, and everyone told to keep well back.

jokes.setup: I'm a lot like the Amazon.
jokes.punchline: Huge, a bit wild, and nobody has ever built a bridge to me.

jokes.setup: Why don't secrets last at quiz night?
jokes.punchline: Somebody always knows the answer, and they can't keep it to themselves.

jokes.setup: My phone and I have a lot in common.
jokes.punchline: We both need charging every few hours and we're useless after midnight.

jokes.setup: Why did the iceberg never open up to anyone?
jokes.punchline: It only ever showed the tip of what it was feeling.

jokes.setup: Why do skeletons make great quiz partners?
jokes.punchline: Nothing gets under their skin.

jokes.setup: Why did the ghost join a dating app?
jokes.punchline: It was tired of everyone looking straight through it.

jokes.setup: Why do vampires love the history round?
jokes.punchline: They were there, and they've been dying to tell you.

jokes.setup: My ex was like a black hole.
jokes.punchline: Gorgeous from a distance, and absolutely nothing escaped.

jokes.setup: Why do mummies never get second dates?
jokes.punchline: They're far too wrapped up in themselves.

jokes.setup: Why did the zombie fail at speed dating?
jokes.punchline: Lovely smile, but no pulse and absolutely no conversation.
